Kids Bible Class · September — Week 2

Hagar and Ishmael

Genesis 21:14-20
Who is always with you?

“God is with you wherever you go.”

Joshua 1:9 (NLT)

God is always with me.

Image 1

Hagar and her young son Ishmael had to leave their home.

They walked out into the big, dry desert with only a little bread and a skin of water.

Image 2

They walked and walked under the hot sun.

Soon the water was all gone.

Hagar did not know what to do.

Image 3

Hagar helped Ishmael rest in the shade of a little bush.

Then she sat down a short way off and began to cry.

She felt all alone and very afraid.

Image 4

But God heard Ishmael crying, and God saw Hagar.

An angel of God called to her, “Do not be afraid! God has heard you.”

God had not forgotten them at all.

Image 5

Then God opened Hagar's eyes, and she saw a well of water!

She filled the water skin and gave Ishmael a big drink.

God stayed with Ishmael as he grew up. And God is always with me.

What We Learn

Hagar and her son Ishmael were all alone in the hot desert with no water left. Hagar felt scared and hopeless. But God saw them, God heard them, and God showed them a well of water. They were never really alone.

For you: Even when you feel alone or forgotten, God sees you and hears you. He knows exactly what you need, and He is always with you.
